legend.title: Gestures
legend.note: One open hand never moves the room. Panning takes both, so you can always reach for a card without the room sliding out from under it.

together.does: Turn hand control on or off

cursor.does: Nothing but the cursor — reach wherever you like

pinch.move: Close thumb and index on a card
pinch.does: Grab it, then move your hand to carry it

release.does: Drop it — it settles onto whatever is nearest

tap.move: Pinch and let go without moving
tap.does: Click it, or open the panel

pan.does: Scroll the room, bringing back what you left off-screen

scale.move: Pinch with both hands and pull apart
scale.does: Make what you are holding bigger or smaller

fist.move: Make a fist, then open it

fistTurn.move: Hold the fist and move it left or right
fistTurn.does: Step back and forth through the windows

slap.move: Throw one open hand sideways, fast
slap.does: Fling the front one that way; the next comes forward

panic.does: Stop everything and leave hand control
